title: Batch compatible local inference requests
goal: Introduce bounded batching only for backends that support it, with per-request deadlines and cancellation; load tests demonstrate throughput changes without violating configured latency or memory limits. Deps (vectors): VC-201-024, VC-201-025, VC-201-042, VC-201-043. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_046_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
